description: Start your first Court Vision league: choosing a team, setting a rotation, the season calendar, trades, the draft, free agency and the offseason.
How Career Mode works in Court Vision: building a player on the wheel of NBA history or in MyPlayer, development, free agency, awards, the Hall of Fame and the Top 100.
How League Hunt works in Court Vision: spinning a six-man squad from basketball history, era rules, best-of-seven series, boosts, shops, difficulty and the Daily Legend.
How the 82-0 Challenge works in Court Vision: building a ten-man team from NBA history, Quick Spin and Franchise Spin, boss teams, lineup rules, chemistry, scoring, the Daily 82-0 and rewards.
How the All-Time Draft works in Court Vision: thirty teams draft every player in NBA history at his best season, AI GMs who draft for need, and a full season under any era's rules.
How the Rebuild Challenge works in Court Vision: take over a real NBA team at its lowest point and win a championship before the clock runs out.
How Court Vision's Real League works: real rosters from any season since 1946-47, real careers, real draft classes, ratings computed from statistics, and Real Player Development.
How Court Vision rates players and teams: player Overall, the 0-100 team rating matched to real win totals, ratings past 99, the Legacy Score and the all-time Top 100.

Inside Court Vision's game engine: every game is played possession by possession, and the box score is counted from what happened. Ball handlers, 14 shot types, contests, turnovers, rebounds, fatigue and badges explained.

Every Court Vision badge and what it does to a player's ratings: shooting, ball handling, defense, finishing, passing and rebounding badges, how players earn them, and the Sandbox-only experimental badges.

How Survival works in Court Vision: draft ten of fourteen all-time greats, tag a Franchise Player, then beat real NBA teams one game at a time while every win costs you a player. Levels, bosses, Shields, emergency signings and scoring.

How Your Career works in Court Vision: build a player at 13, choose a high school, college, pro academy or Europe, declare for the draft, sign contracts and chase awards. Positions, ratings, growth by age and Legacy explained.

How Story Mode works in Court Vision: five chapters from a city park to draft night, then fifteen NBA seasons. Four playing styles, real games on the court, and choices about friends, family and rivals that change your ending.

How coaching and player development work in Court Vision franchise leagues: hiring staff, offensive systems and defensive schemes, rotation styles, practice calendars, development plans, mentors, badges and morale.
